zgwEndpoint.title: ZGW Endpoint
zgwEndpoint.summary: Configuration profile for a single ZGW deployment per gemeente (ZRC/DRC/BRC/ZTC/AC/NRC component URLs).
zgwEndpoint.description: Tracks the per-gemeente ZGW deployment configuration: the six component base URLs (ZRC, DRC, BRC, ZTC, AC, NRC), the bound ZgwClient credential reference, the actief/readOnly write toggles, and the optional mTLS material. Currently addressed only by the inbound status path (NrcNotificationListener via ZrcClient::getStatus) and NrcSubscriptionService; the ZGW write bridge (zaak/document/besluit creation) is not wired in this app. ZGW writes are routed via the openconnector ZGW connector instead. One endpoint per gemeente (gemeenteCode is the natural key). Mapped to Schema.org SoftwareApplication for register tooling.

componenten.description: Component base URLs (each a full base URL with no trailing slash)
componenten.title: Componenten

clientId.description: Reference to the zgwClient id used for this endpoint
clientId.title: Client ID

actief.description: Whether this endpoint is the active write path (write=on) for its gemeente
actief.title: Actief

readOnly.description: If true the endpoint may only be read from; write operations raise
readOnly.title: Read Only

mutualTlsCert.description: Optional vault reference to the PEM-encoded mTLS client certificate
mutualTlsCert.title: Mutual Tls Cert

mutualTlsKey.description: Optional vault reference to the PEM-encoded mTLS private key
mutualTlsKey.title: Mutual Tls Key

zgwClient.title: ZGW Client Credentials
zgwClient.summary: JWT credentials per VNG-API-Common spec for one or more ZgwEndpoints.
zgwClient.description: Holds the clientIdentifier (issued by the gemeente IT team) and the vault reference to the HS256 client secret used to mint per-request JWTs against VNG-API-Common-protected ZGW components. No raw secret is stored on the schema: the secretKluisRef points at a vault entry maintained by gemeente operations. Used by ZgwApiClient.mintJwt() for every outbound call. Mapped to Schema.org CreativeWork (credential-like, no closer Schema.org equivalent).

clientIdentifier.description: VNG API-Common client identifier; sent in JWT iss + client_id claims
clientIdentifier.title: Client Identifier

secretVaultRef.description: Vault reference (e.g. 'vault://zgw/zoetermeer/client-secret') to the HS256 client secret
secretVaultRef.title: Secret Kluis Ref

nrcAbonnement.title: NRC Subscription
nrcAbonnement.summary: Subscription state for one NRC endpoint per ZgwEndpoint (callback URL, bearer secret ref, active kanalen).
nrcAbonnement.description: Tracks the lifecycle of a single Notificaties Routerings Component (NRC) abonnement: the URL NRC returned on POST /api/v1/abonnement, the pipelinq inbox callback URL, the per-abonnement bearer token vault reference used to authenticate inbound NRC POSTs, the subscribed kanalen + filters, and the last-received timestamp. Owned by NrcSubscriptionService; consumed by ZgwNotificationController to authorise inbound callbacks and by NrcNotificationListener to dispatch them. Mapped to Schema.org Action for register tooling.

endpointId.description: Reference to the parent ZgwEndpoint id
endpointId.title: Endpoint ID

abonnementUrl.description: Full URL of the registered NRC abonnement (returned by NRC on POST)
abonnementUrl.title: Abonnement URL

callbackAuth.description: Vault reference (e.g. 'vault://zgw/zoetermeer/nrc-callback-bearer') OR opaque bearer token used by NRC to authenticate inbound callbacks
callbackAuth.title: Callback Auth

kanalen.description: Subscribed kanalen with optional per-kanaal filter map
kanalen.title: Kanalen

latestReceivedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successfully processed NRC notification
latestReceivedOn.title: Laatst Ontvangen Op

zgwResourceMapping.title: ZGW Resource Mapping
zgwResourceMapping.summary: Bidirectional link between a pipelinq entity (request/contact/document) and a ZGW resource URL (zaak/besluit/rol/informatieobject).
zgwResourceMapping.description: ZGW uses absolute URLs as the canonical identifier for zaken, besluiten, rollen and informatieobjecten. This mapping persists the URL + UUID + most-recent ETag per resource so inbound NRC notifications (which reference resources by URL) can be correlated back to the originating pipelinq entity, and so PATCH operations can include If-Match for optimistic concurrency. Multiple mappings per Request are expected during ZGW <-> StUF coexistence migration. Mapped to Schema.org Thing as a pure relation row.

pipelinqEntity.title: Pipelinq Entiteit
